scientific_data.source: USDA Flavonoid Content of Selected Foods Release 3.3 aggregate tables

warnings: V11-W02 inherited catechin/epicatechin stereochemistry/tautomer adjudication remains open; records remain separate.
Tea measurements are USDA aggregate values with N=2 and unpublished source ref 272; original method and observations unavailable.
Held flavonoid values may be aglycone equivalents; they are excluded until analyte semantics fit the schema.
No cooking, recipe dilution, processing retention, bioavailability, clinical, or Stage D risk model is included.
